question: Analyzing several DNA polymerases involved in the replication of E. coli, one of them was found that had low processivity and low synthesis speed, what enzyme could be treated ?:
reasoning_chain: CHAIN: DNA pol III -> high processivity and synthesis speed -> 95% confidence CHAIN: DNA pol I -> low processivity and synthesis speed -> 95%
analysis: Given the characteristics of low processivity and low synthesis speed, the enzyme that could be treated is likely DNA pol I, as it is known to have lower processivity compared to DNA pol III which is the main replicative polymerase in E. coli.
